comments.text: The part that stopped me: about five million people speak Swahili as a first language, and around ninety two million speak it as a second. Its official status in Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda and the DR Congo came from decisions, not demographics, and two of those decisions are very recent: Rwanda in February 2017, Uganda in 2022. Sources are listed in the description if you want to check the figures. If you live in East Africa, which language do you actually use at the market, at work and at home?
